name: ES-1
reason: Mars regolith simulant, not lunar. ESA engineering soil listed in ISECG Table 9 (p.63) under the 'Mars' sub-header of the ESA block — confirmed from a rendered image of the page — and on the ESRIC simulants knowledge base under 'Mars Regolith Simulants'. Confirmed by a reader and an independent checker, 2026-09-23. Retired at the owner's decision: Martian simulants are out of scope.
